title: High-Pass Filter - Band 30 (2300 MHz) for Public Safety Band Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Lena Kowalski

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a High-Pass Filter filter targeting Band 30 (2300 MHz) for Public Safety Band Filter. The filter is designed on 128° YX LiNbO3 substrate with a target center frequency of 4938.1 MHz and bandwidth of 74.1 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Public Safety Band Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: High-Pass Filter
- Frequency Band: Band 30 (2300 MHz)
- Application: Public Safety Band Filter
- Substrate: 128° YX LiNbO3
- Package: CSP (Chip Scale Package)
- Design Tool: Synopsys CustomSim
- Design Center: Osaka Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the High-Pass Filter design targeting Band 30 (2300 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       4938.1 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       74.1 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.6 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 9.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 52.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 41.0 dB
Q Factor:               8516
Temperature Coefficient:-27.3 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.9 x 1.9 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   11
Electrode Material:     Mo/Al
Passivation:            SiO2/Si3N4 stack
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Synopsys CustomSim and load the High-Pass Filter template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: 128° YX LiNbO3 with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 4938.1 MHz, BW 74.1 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.6 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (CSP (Chip Scale Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, 128° YX LiNbO3).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Rohde & Schwarz FSW Signal Analyzer.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 14814 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.6 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 9.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 111 MHz offset >= 52.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 8 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 16.9 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +30 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 2000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 97%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-05-21
Devices Tested:         83
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.27 dB
Return Loss (meas):     11.4 dB
Rejection (meas):       54.8 dB
Isolation (meas):       46.3 dB
Q Factor (meas):        8516
Group Delay Variation:  4.8 ns
Power Handling:         +30 dBm
Die Yield:              88.5%

Result Classification:  CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The High-Pass Filter design demonstrated acceptable performance for Band 30 (2300 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) ESD robustness exceeded specification by 2x margin.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
